name: junction
description: Junction — local AI coding agent bridge for OpenClaw, Hermes, and Souveraine

junction.openclaw.gatewayUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the OpenClaw runtime.

junction.openclaw.configPath.description: Path to the openclaw.json config file for the selected OpenClaw runtime.

junction.hermes.dashboardUrl.description: Local Hermes dashboard URL used for native WebSocket integration.

junction.hermes.wsUrl.description: Local Hermes dashboard JSON-RPC WebSocket URL.

junction.hermes.apiBaseUrl.description: Local Hermes API server URL for REST fallback/status.

junction.hermes.home.description: Hermes home used for the managed hermling test runtime.

junction.souveraine.home.description: HOME directory used for the managed souvieling test runtime.

junction.autoSendFileContext.description: Automatically stage editor context when switching files.

junction.fileContextInterval.description: Interval (in ms) for automatically staging editor context.

enumDescriptions: Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline
Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends; Enter inserts a newline
Enter sends on a single line; multiline requires Ctrl/Cmd+Enter
junction.sendBehavior.description: How the chat composer submits a message.

enumDescriptions: Use the per-bridge setting (or queue if not set)
Hold the message until the current run finishes, then send
Inject the message into the running turn (needs gateway support; falls back to queue)
Stop the current run, then send the new message
junction.followUpMode.description: Global follow-up mode. Per-bridge overrides: junction.openclaw.followUpMode, junction.hermes.followUpMode, junction.souveraine.followUpMode.

junction.openclaw.followUpMode.description: Follow-up mode for OpenClaw. 'default' uses the global junction.followUpMode.

junction.hermes.followUpMode.description: Follow-up mode for Hermes. 'default' uses the global junction.followUpMode.

junction.souveraine.followUpMode.description: Follow-up mode for Souveraine. 'default' uses the global junction.followUpMode.

enumDescriptions: Stream thinking expanded, then auto-collapse to a summary when it finishes
Show a compact 'Thinking… ~N tokens' line while reasoning, then reveal the full text and keep it expanded after finish
junction.reasoningDisplay.description: How reasoning/thinking blocks are displayed in the chat.

junction.checkpoints.enabled.description: Snapshot the workspace at each turn so you can 'Rewind code to here' (uses a shadow git repo in extension storage, never your real .git).

junction.sandboxMode.description: Local UI preference for agent sandbox display. Applied only when the active bridge supports a matching control surface.

junction.approvalMode.description: Local UI preference for approval display. Applied only when the active bridge supports a matching control surface.

junction.extraRichText.description: Enable Pretext-powered extra-rich text rendering with animated text effects (matrix scroll, typewriter, etc.). Uses canvas-based text layout for smoother animations.

junction.todoCodeLensEnabled.description: Show CodeLens actions above TODO/FIXME/HACK comments to send them to Junction.

enumDescriptions: Finished activity folds into a summary accordion ("Edited 2 files, ran 3 commands")
Rows stay inline on a vertical timeline rail; nothing folds
Both: activity folds into the accordion, and the expanded body renders as a timeline rail
junction.activityStream.layout.description: How a turn's tool/activity rows are laid out in the chat stream.

junction.activityStream.rail.description: Show the vertical guide line beside activity rows (timeline/hybrid layouts).

enumDescriptions: Colored status dots (green success, red error, blinking while running)
Neutral dots with a spinner while running
junction.activityStream.dots.description: Status indicator style on activity rows.

junction.steerKeybinding.description: Custom keybinding to steer in-flight runs (e.g., 'Ctrl+Shift+Enter'). Left empty by default (unbound).

junction.showFullHistory.description: Show full chat history on load (locally installed OpenClaw instances only). When enabled, loads up to 1000 messages instead of the default 200. May be slower on large sessions.
